proposals.announcement_evidence: Navy Enterprise Resource Planning support, sustainment and support services

proposals.rationale: The announcement spells the program name exactly as the index carries it, and 0605013N (Information Technology Development) is the PE whose own narrative owns 'Navy Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)'. But the task list is deployment, sustainment, stabilization, operations and business process support, end-user support and training on a fielded business system, and the money named is fiscal 2025 operations and maintenance. O&M sustainment of a deployed system is not an RDT&E development line's own work — this is precisely the appropriation failure mode the 2026-09-04 held-out study found in half its refutations — so the name is present but the attribution claim is not supported.

proposals.announcement_evidence: lead yard support for the DDG 51 class guided missile destroyer program
proposals.rationale: The award exercises options at Bath Iron Works for lead yard support of the DDG 51 class program, and every dollar named is shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) — fiscal 2013, 2015, 2019 and 2020 SCN — which is the appropriation that funds SCN line 2122 DDG-51 itself. Lead yard services are a funded element of the DDG-51 shipbuilding program rather than a platform the contract merely touches: BLI 2122 buys the class, and the lead yard contract is how the class design is sustained and each hull's build is supported. The designator differs from the index row only in punctuation ('DDG 51 class' vs 'DDG-51'), and no other row in this org's index carries that designator — 0204202N's rows are DDG 1000/DDG-1000, a different ship class.

refute_a.reason: Money and mission both hold: 95% of the obligation is shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) across five ship increments (FY13/15/19/20/21), and SCN is the appropriation of doc-341 line 2122 DDG-51; lead yard services are a funded cost element inside the DDG-51 SCN line (the class design agent), not generic engineering support attached to a line of a different color, and the announcement names the DDG 51 class program itself rather than a platform the line does not buy. The only residue is a 5% FY21 RDT&E tail, too small to break a 95% SCN match, and 2122 is a single-class ship line, not a rollup or catch-all.

refute_b.reason: "DDG-51" is owned by exactly one row of N.tsv (2122, doc 341); every other DDG row names a different thing — 0204202N/0947/2119 are DDG-1000 class lines, 0603564N owns only "DDG-51 Flt III Concept Development" (concept work, not lead yard support) and 0900 owns "DDG Modernization (DDG MOD) Program" (in-service mod) — so "DDG 51 class", which differs from the row only in punctuation, has no competing owner in this index.

proposals.lexicon_quote: FA-18E/F	0145	330	F/A-18E/F (Fighter) Hornet

refute_a.reason: The whole $54,390,678 is fiscal 2013 and 2014 aircraft procurement (Navy), which is the appropriation of doc-330 line 0145 F/A-18E/F (Fighter) Hornet, and the work is full-rate production of the very aircraft that line procures — the most direct form of a line's own work, with no platform-versus-program gap and no rollup (the 0145 rows under doc 338 are the ammunition book, and the proposal correctly cites doc 330). refute_b.reason: The exact name "Dual Band Decoy (DBD)" is owned by three different lines in this same index — 0604270N (doc 340), procurement BLI 0182 "Air Expendable Countermeasures" (doc 338) and 0576 "ALE-55 and the Dual Band Decoy (DBD)" (doc 330) — and the announcement's own scope, "design, development, integration, testing, production, and delivery of the Dual Band Decoy countermeasure," reads onto the procurement owners at least as well as onto the development line, so the name cannot pick one; the record text is truncated mid-funding-sentence and its `amounts` show three separate obligations, so the appropriation the proposal leans on is not even fully visible, let alone decisive.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the Trident (D5) MK 6 guidance system production with failure verification, test, repair and recertification of inertial measurement units, electronic assemblies, and electronic modules
proposals.lexicon_quote: Mk6 MOD1 Guidance System (GS)	1250	342	Trident II Mods

Among the record's four lake PIIDs, N00030-17-C-0008 is the Strategic Systems Programs FY17 contract that matches this January 2017 award and its FY17 WPN obligation.

refute_a.reason: The 'failure verification, test, repair and recertification' language invites the O&M-sustainment-on-a-procurement-line failure mode, but the announcement names no O&M at all: $45,663,167 is fiscal 2017 weapons procurement (Navy), the appropriation of doc-342 line 1250 Trident II Mods, with $7,867,000 of United Kingdom funds for the shared D5 program. The Mk6 guidance system is a named element of 1250's own narrative rather than a platform the contract supports, 1250 is the only line in this org's index carrying a Mk 6 guidance row, and a mods line whose every element is a named sub-program is not a rollup of the excluded catch-all kind. The chosen PIID is the Strategic Systems Programs contract that carries this Draper award within a multi-award article.

refute_b.reason: No other row in N.tsv carries a MK 6 or guidance-system name — 0101221N owns only "Reentry Body Assembly (RBA)" and "W-93 / Mk 7", and the TRIPER rows at 0950 and 5358 are equipment-replacement lines — so "Trident (D5) MK 6 guidance system" has exactly one candidate owner; the only identity gap is that the announcement omits the row's "MOD1" qualifier and its recertification work touches already-fielded units, and there is no baseline-MK6 row in this index for that evidence to go to instead.

proposals.lexicon_quote: Mission Modules (MM)	0603596N	340	LCS Mission Modules
proposals.rationale: The announcement's phrase is the PE's own subject — 0603596N is titled LCS Mission Modules and owns the MCM and SUW mission packages — but the modification is engineering services funded 61 percent by fiscal 2021 operation and maintenance (Navy) and 24 percent by other procurement, with RDT&E only 14 percent. In-service engineering sustainment paid from O&M attached to an RDT&E development line is the documented failure mode, and 'engineering services' with no named module or increment is the generic-services pattern §3 rejects.

proposals.announcement_evidence: to provide services for the U.S. and United Kingdom Trident II D5 strategic weapon system programs
proposals.lexicon_quote: Strategic Weapons System (SWS)	5358	333	Strategic Missile Systems Equip
proposals.rationale: The phrase 'strategic weapon system' matches BLI 5358's row, but the identical name 'Strategic Weapons System (SWS)' is also owned by BLI 1045 (COLUMBIA Class Submarine), and the phrase itself is close to generic. The contract is a broad services modification spanning four distinct subjects — the US and UK Trident II D5 programs, SSGN attack weapon systems, nuclear weapon surety and future concepts — across a dozen work locations, so no share of it can be attributed to the Strategic Missile Systems Equipment line's own work. Broad support services plus a two-way name collision keeps this below the standard.

proposals.announcement_evidence: Global Positioning System-Based Positioning, Navigation and Timing Service (GPNTS) hardware production units
proposals.lexicon_quote: The GPS-based PNT Service (GPNTS)	2657	333	Navstar GPS Receivers (SPACE)
proposals.rationale: The contract buys GPNTS hardware production units, and the funds obligated are fiscal 2016 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) and other procurement (Navy) — OPN being the appropriation of BLI 2657, the line whose narrative owns GPNTS. Hardware production units of the named system against the procurement line that fields it is the line's own work, not support to a platform. The announcement spells out the acronym the index row abbreviates ('Global Positioning System-Based Positioning, Navigation and Timing Service (GPNTS)' vs 'The GPS-based PNT Service (GPNTS)'), so the tie is the identical acronym plus the same expansion, hence alias rather than exact-name. GPNTS is carried by no other PE in this org's index.

refute_a.reason: Other procurement (Navy) is named in the obligation, and OPN is the appropriation of doc-333 line 2657, whose narrative owns GPNTS by name; the deliverable is GPNTS hardware production units, which is the line's own item rather than a platform the contract merely supports, and 'Navstar GPS Receivers (SPACE)' is a specific equipment line, not a catch-all. Two attacks fail: the IDIQ form is not the §3 reject, because that bullet covers ceilings naming no program and this one names both the program and the deliverable; and the fiscal 2016 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds sharing the $2,111,585 buy the same units for new-construction hulls, so the mixed color dilutes how much of the award executes 2657 without making the claim that it executes 2657 untrue.

refute_b.reason: "GPNTS" appears in exactly one row (2657, doc 333) and the announcement's spelled-out "Global Positioning System-Based Positioning, Navigation and Timing Service" matches that row's own expansion, so the alias is real rather than invented; the other GPS-bearing rows name different systems (0670 MGUE, 0204229N/2301 anti-jam receivers, 0604280N GPS Modernization, 4733 GPSSR), none of which this announcement mentions, so no alternative owner competes for the evidence.

proposals.announcement_evidence: firm-fixed-price blanket purchase agreement (BPA) for production of the C2P hardware system
proposals.lexicon_quote: C2P Modernization (MOD)	0604280N	340	Joint Tactical Radio System - Navy (JTRS-Navy)
proposals.rationale: C2P is named and the only PE in this index that owns it is 0604280N, whose narrative covers C2P Modernization within the JTRS-Navy development portfolio. The action, however, is a blanket purchase agreement for production of up to 74 C2P hardware units per vendor across four vendors, with program management, testing and logistics to deliver them — serial production, which an RDT&E development line does not buy. No appropriation is named in the record to contradict that reading, so the award most likely executes a procurement line this index does not carry, and the attribution to the development PE is unsupported.
